messages:
Andrew: Quick sync — two quick asks for tomorrow's panel (8:30am PST run). 1) Is the panel runbook the latest? 2) Can someone pick up the CR for the candidate's takehome before 8am PST? Also need scribe + debrief lead confirmed.

Maya: I updated the runbook, link here: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/panel-ops (section 'day-of' updated). I added a scribe rotation + live notes template.

Samir: @Andrew I can take the CR, will have comments and a small README fix by 6am PST. Focus areas: test failures + public API names.

Priya: I'll lead the debrief. Please add candidate ID 2026-042 to the calendar invite. FYI I noted a rubric tweak — system-design clarity +1 if they justify tradeoffs.

Andrew: Thanks. @Maya quick check — is the recording consent language in there?

Maya: Yep, under 'logging & privacy' (search for `recording-consent`). Copying the snippet:
```
Please confirm candidate consent before recording. If consent is declined, switch recording off and note reason in the debrief form.
```

Alex: FYI infra has a maintenance window 03:00-04:00 PST but it won't touch the panel infra. No impact expected. :thumbsup:

recruiter-bot: Reminder added: candidate travel note updated on profile (expenses flagged).

Andrew: Cool — final checklist:
- scribe: Maya
- debrief lead: Priya
- CR owner: Samir
- buffer: 10m added to calendar
If anything changes ping here and I'll escalate.

Samir: CR done — merged README tweak, left two comments on edge-case handling. All green on CI. :white_check_mark:
